briefs.claim_en: The image in this post shows people in India celebrating the successful landing of the Chandrayaan-3 mission near the Moon's south pole.
briefs.brief_en: India successfully landed its Chandrayaan-3 mission near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, leading to widespread celebrations across the country. People were seen cheering, dancing, sharing sweets, and waving national flags. Prime Minister Narendra Modi declared August 23 as National Space Day. However, some images circulating online, purportedly showing these celebrations, have been identified as being from the 2014 Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan) success.
gaps_en: No direct matches were found for the specific image in the post, and search results are generic, not showing the image in the context of Chandrayaan-3 celebrations.
